blocks.content: We have already used printf() in our previous lessons. Its primary purpose is to print output on the screen.
In this lesson, we'll cover the printf() function in greater detail. We will learn to:

items: Print only the required number of digits after the decimal point

blocks.content: Also, we will cover common mistakes that you might face using printf().
